data.action: 撑壁橱塌腰回眸双手反剪扯拉链，水手服掀起露出条纹胖次，羞怒瞪视泛泪
data.description: 【白银家玄关壁橱前·放学后】换便服时秀知院水手服背后的隐形拉链意外咬死在裙边。圭双手反剪在背后拼命拉扯，过紧的成年礼服勒得小腹深陷，水手服下摆被高高掀起，露出浅蓝条纹纯棉内裤与白嫩细腿。她气急败坏地回头瞪视，眼角挂着羞怒的泪珠——「不要站在那里发呆啦！快过来帮我把咬住的布拉出来啊笨蛋！」
data.location: 白银家玄关壁橱前·放学后
data.nsfwProse: Bracing against the entryway closet as her sailor uniform zipper jams at the hip, Kei Shirogane pushes her skirt up over striped panties, glaring back in tearful indignation.
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane leans forward against the apartment entryway closet, her pristine Shuchiin sailor uniform jammed tightly at the side zipper. Her slender, arched lower back pushes her pleated navy skirt up to reveal pale hips and blue-and-white striped cotton panties strained against smooth skin. Glancing back over her shoulder with watery sapphire eyes and furiously flushed cheeks, she snaps petulantly for assistance while her fists strain behind her back. Cinematic horizontal framing, cramped Japanese hallway lighting, detailed background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
data.title: 白银圭 · 秀知院成年后部制服拉链卡壳事故 ·「衣服卡住了啦！……再看把你眼睛挖出来！」
